name: Ashley Reed
text: Design Director, with a background in music and digital design. Ashley makes cinematic experiences where the technology serves the story.

name: Veronica Reed
text: Account Director and Project Manager. Veronica brings interactive and audiovisual experiences to life, and runs projects from concept to execution.

name: Emile Pascoe
text: Lead Technical Artist, specialising in Unreal Engine. Emile comes from VR development for architectural firms: real-time rendering, optimisation and immersive environments.

name: Jonas Johansson
text: Lead Technical Director. Jonas is an artist, educator and designer working with motion graphics, immersive media and audiovisual art, formerly at Moment Factory, Field.io and KRAM/WEISSHAAR.

name: Rose Hallgren
text: Architect, artist and designer based in Stockholm. Rose's practice moves across materials and disciplines, wherever a project, vision or whisper may lead.
